scope: Read-only SQL endpoint queries. Aggregates only. Bronze CD_Bronze_Lakehouse.cd_bronze_procore_submittals / cd_bronze_procore_rfis; silver CD_Silver_Lakehouse.cd_silver_submittals (still built with the pre-fix mapping). Rows with _project_id NULL excluded, as gold does. Past-due and days-open evaluated as of 2026-09-14.
caveat_truncation: The SQL endpoint caps payload at 8000 chars: 1722 of 2474 submittal rows are valid JSON. Bronze figures are on that subset. Truncated rows are the larger (more approvers) payloads, i.e. almost all closed. Full-population status split is taken from silver status_label (all 2474 rows), which needs no date field.

fix.IsOpen_submittals: NOT closed AND NOT draft; closed = responded_date present OR status_category = 'Closed'; draft = status_category (else status name) = 'Draft'
fix.DaysOpen: today - created, open items only (both arms of fct_RfiSubmittal; new on fct_QcSubmittal)
fix.TurnaroundDays: responded - created, responded items only (fct_QcSubmittal; new on fct_RfiSubmittal)

open_submittals.note: before counted 887 Closed-category submittals with a distribution/close date as open, plus every draft

qc_avg_submittal_turnaround_as_previousl.note: old TurnaroundDays fell back to today-created on every non-responded row, and the measure averaged all non-blank rows

expected_after_fix.note: Open-status rows carry no distributed_at/closed_at on the valid subset, so open = the 'Open' status count

avg_days_open_rfi_arm.note: DaysOpen is now open-only; before it mixed closed-RFI turnaround into the average
